mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS senderId, u.username AS name, COALESCE(u.image, 'default_avatar.png') AS avatar, CASE WHEN pm.image IS NOT NULL THEN '[图片]' ELSE LEFT(pm.message, 50) END AS lastMessage, DATE_FORMAT(pm.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastMessageTime, COALESCE(unread.unread_count, 0) AS unreadCount -- 添加未读消息数 FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END AS contact_id, MAX(id) AS max_msg_id FROM private_messages WHERE (sender_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted_sender = 0) OR (receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted_receiver = 0) GROUP BY contact_id ) AS last_msgs INNER JOIN private_messages pm ON last_msgs.max_msg_id = pm.id INNER JOIN users u ON last_msgs.contact_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( -- 添加未读消息统计子查询 SELECT sender_id, COUNT(*) AS unread_count FROM private_messages WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 AND is_deleted_receiver = 0 GROUP BY sender_id ) AS unread ON unread.sender_id = u.id ORDER BY pm.create_time DESC

SELECT id, sender_id AS senderId, receiver_id AS receiverId, CASE WHEN image IS NOT NULL THEN '[图片]' ELSE message END AS message, create_time AS createTime, CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS type FROM private_messages WHERE ( (sender_id = #{userId} AND receiver_id = #{contactId} AND is_deleted_sender = 0) OR (sender_id = #{contactId} AND receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted_receiver = 0) ) ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: insert into private_messages( sender_id, receiver_id, message, create_time) values (#{senderId},#{receiverId},#{message},#{createTime})
